title: Generative Tutorial: Towards Live Contextualized Visual Instructions for Physical Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2609.24955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual instructions for physical tasks are typically authored in one context and followed in another, requiring users to translate demonstrated tools, materials, and spatial relationships into their own environment. We introduce Generative Tutorial, a conceptual framework for live visual instruction that depicts intended outcomes and actions within the user's environment and task flow. A formative evaluation of state-of-the-art image and video generation identifies failures and potential benefits across 15 physical tasks. Drawing on these findings, we build an augmented-reality prototype system that proactively generates goal images and demonstration videos using observed workspace context and predicted visual outcomes of preceding actions. A 24-participant lab study found higher task performance quality, greater perceived workspace correspondence, and shorter step-confirmation intervals with the system than with pre-authored guidance.

translated_title: 生成式教程：迈向面向物理任务的实时情境化视觉指导
translated_abstract: 针对物理任务的视觉指导通常是在一个情境中制作，而在另一个情境中被使用，这要求用户将演示中的工具、材料和空间关系转换到自己的环境中。我们提出了生成式教程，这是一个实时视觉指导的概念框架，能够在用户的环境和任务流程中描绘预期结果和操作。通过对最先进的图像和视频生成技术进行形成性评估，我们识别了其在15项物理任务中的失败案例和潜在益处。基于这些发现，我们构建了一个增强现实原型系统，该系统利用观察到的工位环境上下文和前序动作的预测视觉结果，主动生成目标图像和演示视频。一项有24名参与者参与的实验室研究发现，与预先制作的指导相比，使用该系统能带来更高的任务完成质量、更强的工位环境对应感，以及更短的步骤确认间隔。
tldr: 该论文提出“生成式教程”概念框架及增强现实原型系统，能根据用户实际工位环境实时生成情境化的目标图像和演示视频，实验证明其相比预先制作的指导显著提升了任务完成质量和环境对应感。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Generative Tutorial," a conceptual framework and augmented-reality prototype system that live-generates contextualized goal images and demonstration videos within users' actual workspaces, demonstrating higher task performance quality and greater workspace correspondence compared to pre-authored guidance.
